author: m.kalinin
content:
To <@592004585506340885> comment on `block_hash` check in CL and no independent EL forks. I think that if payload layout changes in a way that affects the block_hash then it is very likely that payload representation on CL side will change as well implying that CL fork will be required.

I.e. any change to block hash almost certainly won't happen without a CL fork.

Based on the above, `payload_root` vs `block_hash` boils down to change data structures during the testnet fork process vs introducing RLP into CL spec. The latter has an option to introduce `payload_root` in any future fork.
